title: IT-tekniker Fredrika Bremergymnasiet
description:
**Välkommen att utvecklas med oss**


Fredrika Bremergymnasiet ligger centralt i Haninge, med goda kommunikationer och cirka tio minuters promenad från pendeltåget.


Vi är en av länets största gymnasieskolor med drygt 2 100 elever på 13 program. Hos oss ryms både högskoleförberedande program och yrkesprogram, med en stor bredd av inriktningar. Flera av våra utbildningar kan också kombineras med våra idrottsakademier, där elever från hela Stockholmsområdet och andra delar av landet utvecklas inom sin idrott parallellt med sina studier.


Som medarbetare hos oss blir du en del av en stor och kunnig organisation där vi arbetar tillsammans för att ge våra elever en utbildning av hög kvalitet. Vi värdesätter engagemang, samarbete och ett prestigelöst förhållningssätt och vill vara en arbetsplats där vi lär av och tillsammans med varandra.

  

**Ditt uppdrag**


Tjänsten som IT-tekniker innefattar flera olika arbetsuppgifter och ansvarsområden. Det viktigaste för oss är att du tycker om att arbeta med både elever och personal. Att svara på frågor lösa akuta problem, felsökning och vardagliga IT-problem är något du gör med nyfikenhet och initiativförmåga. Du vill lära känna alla på skolan och hjälpa till med att få en IT-miljö som bidrar till varje elevs måluppfyllelse, du sätter en ära i att skapa goda kontakter med våra elever.


Ditt uppdrag blir att sköta den dagliga IT-driften och hantering av alla skolans digitala enheter. Som en del av arbetet ingår även att kunna göra enklare reparationer av fasta installationer samt de digitala enheterna. I tjänsten ingår även att vara kontaktperson mot centrala IT-enheten, utbildningsförvaltning och leverantörer.

  

**Det här söker vi hos dig**


Krav är gymnasial utbildning eller utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att arbeta som IT-tekniker eller liknande tjänst. Är även meriterande att arbeta i AD, MDM/JAMF samt i TEAMS och Google miljö. Är meriterande om du har erfarenhet at ha arbetat med driften av nätverk och brandväggar. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av att arbeta på en skola.


Du är lyhörd och tycker om att ge service och göra andra nöjda med din hjälp. För dig är det viktigt att genom engagemang, samarbetsförmåga och god kommunikation leverera med kvalitet och att vara en person på en arbetsplats som andra kan lita på och vända sig till. Du lär dig snabbt och det du inte kan vill du lära dig eftersom du är en person som vill arbeta självständigt och för verksamhetens bästa. Att möta varje elev, kollega och besökare på fredrika Bremergymnasiet med ett glatt bemötande är något du sätter yrkesstolthet i.


Du har inga problem med att hantera arbetstoppar som kan förekomma i början och slutet på läsåret i denna tjänst. Vi söker en person som är strukturerad och organiserad i sitt arbete då det ingår många olika arbetsuppgifter som skall hanteras. Det krävs även ibland att man har ett gott tålamod.

  

**Det här kan vi erbjuda dig**


På Fredrika Bremergymnasiet blir du en del av en stor och engagerad organisation med många kunniga kollegor och en bred samlad kompetens. Här finns goda möjligheter att samarbeta, utbyta erfarenheter och fortsätta utvecklas i din profession.


Vi erbjuder en modern och välutrustad skola med fina lärmiljöer och en verksamhet där det finns utrymme för idéer, initiativ och pedagogisk utveckling. Som medarbetare i Haninge kommun har du också tillgång till friskvårdsbidrag och andra personalförmåner.


Framför allt erbjuder vi ett viktigt och meningsfullt uppdrag – att tillsammans skapa de bästa möjliga förutsättningarna för våra elevers lärande, utveckling och framtid.

title: Data Scientist / Data Engineer
description:
### **About Nucs AI**

Nucs AI is revolutionizing cancer care through cutting-edge AI and medical imaging technology. Founded in 2024 by a multidisciplinary team of oncologists, AI researchers, and healthcare innovators, we’re tackling one of medicine’s most pressing challenges: the growing demand for accurate, timely cancer diagnostics in the face of rising scan volumes and limited radiologist capacity.


We sit at the intersection of diagnostics and treatment planning - building AI-powered tools at the convergence of medical imaging, radioligand therapy, and artificial intelligence. Starting with prostate cancer and expanding across oncology, we partner with world-leading medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies across the US, Europe, and Australia to bring precision oncology into everyday clinical practice.


Our mission is to enhance diagnostic precision and expand access to expert-level cancer care, improving patient outcomes worldwide. We’re venture-backed, early-stage, and building a team that blends deep clinical expertise with engineering intensity - moving with the rigor the medical field demands and the speed the problem deserves.

### **What you'll do**

* Build auditable data pipelines for large clinical, diagnostic, and medical imaging datasets in the cloud.
* Own statistical analysis across clinical studies, diagnostic performance, model evaluation, and data quality.
* Apply classical machine learning and deep learning methods to data analysis problems.
* Automated ontology induction from medical documents using large language models.
* Build dashboards and data observability tooling.
* Maintain strong data lineage, provenance, traceability, and reproducibility across data workflows.
* Produce analyses and supporting evidence that hold up in regulatory submissions and audits.

### **What we're looking for**

* A master's degree or PhD in computer science, data science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, physics, economics or a related discipline
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering or a closely related field, with demonstrated development of production-grade data solutions Proficiency in SQL and Python and software-development standards such as Git-based workflows, automated testing, code reviews and CI/CD
* Comfort working with medical imaging formats including DICOM and NIfTI.
* Practical experience with classical machine learning and explainable ML.
* Working fluency with deep learning and modern LLM tooling.
* Experience with cloud data infrastructure. We use GCP, but equivalent platforms are fine.
* A strong working understanding of data lineage, provenance, traceability, and reproducibility.
* Unusual attention to detail around data completeness, validity, consistency, and edge cases.
* Flexibility at adapting to new technologies
* Awareness of good software practices

### **Strongly preferred**

* Experience with medical imaging -clinical trials, pharmaceutical, healthcare or another regulated industry is an advantage
* Experience with knowledge graphs / temporal knowledge graphs
* Experience producing statistical analyses or technical evidence used in a regulatory submission.
* Experience with model interpretability techniques such as SHAP.

### **Why Nucs AI**

* **Mission with real impact** – Your work directly improves how cancer patients are diagnosed and treated.
* **Ground-floor opportunity** – Early-stage company, meaningful equity, and outsized influence on the direction we take.
* **World-class collaborators** – Work alongside leading oncologists, nuclear medicine physicians, and AI researchers globally.
* **Massive market tailwinds** – Radioligand therapy and AI-driven oncology are multi-billion dollar growth markets.
* **Autonomy and flexibility** – Remote-first, flexible working. We hire great people and trust them to deliver.
* **Equity upside** – Competitive equity package. We’re building something big and want you to share in it.

### **How to Apply**


Submit your resume and a brief note on why this role and Nucs AI excite you.

### **Equal Opportunity**


Nucs AI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Däremot ser vi gärna att du har ett intresse av att bredda din kompetens, utforska nya tekniker och bidra även inom områden som ligger utanför din nuvarande erfarenhet. Vi tror att olika kompetenser och perspektiv, tillsammans med en vilja att utvecklas, är en viktig förutsättning för att lyckas med vårt gemensamma uppdrag.


**Personliga egenskaper**


Du är en analytisk och lösningsorienterad person som tycker om att förstå komplexa sammanhang och omsätta idéer och behov till fungerande lösningar. Du är nyfiken, ser möjligheter och trivs i en miljö där teknik och arbetssätt utvecklas över tid.


Du tar ansvar för ditt arbete, arbetar självständigt när det behövs och har samtidigt en stark vilja att samarbeta och lära tillsammans med andra. Du delar gärna med dig av din kunskap, är prestigelös i mötet med nya frågeställningar och ser värdet av att ta tillvara andras erfarenheter och perspektiv.


Du har ett kvalitetsmedvetet förhållningssätt och drivs av att skapa robusta, säkra och tillgängliga lösningar som bidrar till verklig verksamhetsnytta. Samtidigt är du inte rädd för att utmana invanda arbetssätt eller prova nya vägar när det kan leda till bättre resultat.


Arbetet innebär många kontaktytor, både inom IT-avdelningen och med andra delar av Tullverket samt externa parter. Därför är det viktigt att du har god kommunikativ förmåga, är bra på att skapa relationer och bidrar till ett öppet och dialogorienterat samarbetsklimat.


För dig är Tullverkets värdegrund; Helhetssyn – Nytänkande - Ansvarstagande, något helt naturligt.


Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Ett spännande och stimulerande jobb med goda utvecklingsmöjligheter. Tullverket och IT-avdelningen är en erkänt vänlig arbetsplats där vi värderar trivsel och kultur högt – att ha kul på jobbet är en framgångsfaktor. title: Säkerhetsspecialist inom produktutveckling
description:
Datasäkerhetsansvarig Kronobergs län
Heltid Publicerad: 20 november 2026 Sök senast: **31 december 2026**
På Aveki utvecklar vi egna mjukvaruprodukter och arbetar nära både tekniken och våra kunder. Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med och stärka säkerheten i våra produkter och utvecklingsprocesser. Hos oss får du kombinera praktiskt säkerhetsarbete med möjligheten att påverka och utveckla vårt arbete med cybersäkerhet.


**Om Aveki**


Vi utvecklar GIS-baserade verksamhetssystem för samhällsbyggnadssektorn. Vår specialitet är helhetslösningar för kommuner och organisationer som behöver integrera geografisk information med annan verksamhetsdata. Över hälften av Sveriges kommuner och pastorat är kunder till oss och vi har vuxit varje år sedan starten 2001.


Vi är certifierade enligt ISO 27001 och arbetar strukturerat och långsiktigt med informationssäkerhet. Våra kunder verkar inom områden där kraven på säkerhet är höga, och vi behöver kontinuerligt förhålla oss till nya säkerhetskrav och regelverk, bland annat NIS2.


**Rollen**


Vi stärker nu vårt arbete med produktsäkerhet och inrättar därför en ny roll med särskilt fokus på säkerheten i våra produkter och utvecklingsprocesser. Som säkerhetsspecialist får du en viktig roll i att driva och utveckla säkerhetsarbetet kopplat till våra produkter, utvecklingsmiljöer och processer.


Du arbetar både praktiskt och långsiktigt med produktsäkerhet. Det handlar bland annat om att ansvara för vår sårbarhetshantering, planera och samordna säkerhetstester och penetrationstester och följa upp resultaten samt bidra med hotmodellering och säkerhetsperspektiv vid tekniska förändringar.


En central del av uppdraget är att driva och samordna vårt arbete med Cyber Resilience Act (CRA). Du arbetar med att omsätta förordningens krav i praktiken, bland annat genom att utveckla arbetssätt för säker produktutveckling, sårbarhetshantering och dokumentation samt följa upp säkerheten genom produkternas livscykel.


Du samordnar arbetet i vårt AppSec-team och samarbetar nära utvecklingsansvarig, utvecklingsteamen och DevOps-teamet. Du har också ett nära samarbete med vår informationssäkerhetsansvariga kring bland annat riskhantering, säkerhetsincidenter och efterlevnad av säkerhetskrav.


**Vår teknikmiljö**


Vi utvecklar våra produkter främst i .NET och C#, med lösningar för både desktop, webb och appar, och använder Azure DevOps som utvecklingsplattform. Produkterna installeras on-prem hos kunderna och används i verksamhetskritiska miljöer. Det gör säker leverans, patchbarhet och tydlig sårbarhetskommunikation till centrala delar av säkerhetsarbetet.


**Vem är du?**

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling och tekniskt säkerhetsarbete, med god förståelse för hur säkerhet kan integreras i utvecklingsprocessen. Du har kunskap om säker utveckling, sårbarhetshantering och säkerhetstester och är van att arbeta i eller nära utvecklingsteam och har erfarenhet av att omsätta säkerhetskrav och regelverk i praktiska arbetssätt.


Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av systematiskt informationssäkerhetsarbete och ISO 27001 samt kunskap om riskhantering och säkerhetskrav kopplade till CRA och NIS2.


Som person är du analytisk, nyfiken och ansvarstagande. Du tycker om att sätta dig in i tekniska frågor men har också förmåga att se helheten. Du trivs med att samarbeta, dela kunskap och driva frågor framåt, och kan förklara säkerhetsfrågor på ett sätt som andra förstår.


**Varför Aveki?**


Du får möjlighet att påverka hur vi arbetar med säkerhet, vara med och utveckla våra arbetssätt och växa tillsammans med verksamheten.


Vi erbjuder en gedigen introduktion, kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling och en kultur som präglas av samarbete och kunskapsdelning. Vi värnar om balans mellan arbetsliv och fritid och erbjuder bland annat friskvård, hälsoundersökning och sjukförsäkring.


**Ansök redan idag**

title: IFS Cloud Consultants
description:
### **Your New Role**


We’re looking for two senior IFS Cloud consultants to help our client set up a new legal entity as part of an expansion. The project covers a local warehouse, intercompany flows and an end-to-end Order-to-Cash process. You’ll work closely with the client’s IoT, Finance, Logistics and IT teams and take ownership of one of the two consulting assignments below.

**Finance & Company Setup**

* Set up the new legal entity in IFS Cloud, from company creation and basic data through to go-live.
* Configure accounting, the chart of accounts, posting control, invoicing and related finance processes.
* Set up intercompany sales and invoicing, including direct deliveries between group companies.
* Migrate relevant data from the existing site.

**Sales & Supply Chain**

* Set up the new site in IFS Cloud, including the warehouse structure and basic data.
* Configure Sales and Supply Chain processes for order handling, inventory and purchasing.
* Design and implement intercompany supply chain flows, including direct deliveries between group companies.
* Plan and carry out data migration.

*In either assignment, you’ll handle CRIMs, configurations and smaller developments, troubleshoot issues and propose solutions. You’ll also help define integration requirements or build integrations where relevant, document your work and share knowledge with the team.*

### **Company Presentation**


Our client is a leading provider of internet, mobile, and TV services for both consumers and businesses. Employees help develop innovative solutions that connect people, entertain, and simplify everyday life.

### **Good to Know**

**Scope of employment**: Full-time, 100%  

**Type of contract**: Fixed-term employment as a consultant via JobBusters.  

**Working model**: Stockholm, on-site at least three days per week  

**Start date**: As soon as possible, preferably by 1 December 2026  

**End date**: 5 months, with the possibility of extension  

**In your application**: Please ensure that your CV clearly demonstrates how you meet the qualifications required by the client.

### **To succeed in this role, you will need:**

* 6+ years of hands-on experience with IFS Cloud.
* Experience with CRIMs, configuration and development.
* Experience working in a fast-paced environment, with the ability to take ownership, work independently and investigate complex issues.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills.
* Fluency in English. Swedish is an advantage.

**For Finance & Company Setup**

* Strong knowledge of IFS Finance, including accounting, invoicing and intercompany processes.
* Proven experience setting up new companies in IFS.
* Experience building integrations or specifying integration requirements is a strong advantage.

**For Sales & Supply Chain**

* Strong knowledge of the IFS Sales and Supply Chain modules.
* Proven experience setting up new sites and intercompany supply chain flows.
* Experience planning and carrying out data migrations.
* Ability to build integrations or specify integration requirements.

### **What we Offer**

* Secure employment with a collective bargaining agreement, insurance coverage and occupational pension
* Wellness allowance and employee discounts and offers via Benifex (e.g., health, leisure, transport and healthcare)
* Flex pension and access to the Lifeplan pension advisory service
* Additional compensation during parental leave
* Occupational health services
* Long-term assignments and a dedicated Consultant Manager for personal support
* Opportunities to build valuable experience, expand your network and grow your future career

### **We look forward to receiving your application**


We review applications on an ongoing basis. As recruitment processes in the consulting industry can move quickly, the position may be filled before the advertised deadline — so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
**Build something monumental for Healthcare!**
==============================================

  

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.


We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

**About the role**


You will build and operate security controls that protect Tandem’s cloud environments and the sensitive patient data entrusted to us.


You will join the security team, reporting to the Head of Security and working closely with our platform team. Our infrastructure engineers build and run our cloud environments. You will be their security engineering partner, contributing directly to infrastructure repositories and delivering improvements together.


The work spans cloud resource access, workload identities, networks, Kubernetes, data protection, and the systems we use to deploy infrastructure. You might implement a workload access policy, strengthen cluster isolation, or build checks that show whether a control still works as intended.


Azure is a key environment, alongside providers including Scaleway and Deutsche Telekom. Kubernetes, Terraform, and Argo CD are important parts of our stack.


You will have substantial implementation ownership and room to shape technical direction as the team grows. We welcome applications from associate through staff-level engineers. We will agree the level and scope of the role based on the capabilities and experience you demonstrate during the hiring process.

 **What you will do**

* Build, deploy, and maintain cloud security controls alongside platform engineers.
* Strengthen cloud resource access and workload identities, including permissions, authentication, and credential management.
* Improve network and workload protection through isolation, secure configuration, and Kubernetes security controls.
* Protect cloud data through storage access controls, encryption, and secrets and key management.
* Build security checks and guardrails into infrastructure code and deployment workflows.
* Improve visibility into cloud assets, exposed services, configuration weaknesses, and gaps in control coverage.
* Work with platform colleagues to prioritise and remediate infrastructure vulnerabilities.
* Help protect backups, recovery credentials, and emergency access, and validate security recovery scenarios.
* Collaborate with our Detection and Response Engineer on cloud telemetry, monitoring, and incident response capabilities.
* Test control effectiveness, investigate failures, and adapt controls as our infrastructure and product evolve.
* Document implementations, operating procedures, and technical decisions so others can maintain and build on your work.


Your ownership and the complexity of your work will grow with your level. You will have support from security and platform colleagues, whether you are delivering a defined improvement or leading work across teams.

 **What success looks like**


Our cloud security controls address meaningful business risks and work reliably in practice. We can identify gaps in coverage, detect control failures, and verify that improvements have reduced exposure.


Security controls become a dependable part of how we build and operate infrastructure. They remain effective as our environments change, with clear ownership, useful documentation, and manageable operational demands.

 **What you bring**

* Practical experience with Kubernetes and an understanding of how access, networking, and workload configuration affect its security.
* Experience building or operating cloud infrastructure. Azure experience is preferred, and experience with AWS or another cloud is relevant.
* An understanding of cloud security principles, with experience in areas such as identity, networking, workload protection, or data protection.
* The ability to use code or automation to implement changes, investigate problems, and reduce repetitive work.
* An approach to testing and troubleshooting that considers security, reliability, and operational impact.
* The ability to explain your reasoning, work through trade-offs, and collaborate with infrastructure engineers.
* Clear communication, useful documentation, and a willingness to ask questions and incorporate feedback.


We assess technical depth, independence, and scope of ownership against the level of the role. We care more about demonstrated capability than a particular degree, certification, or job title.

 **Bonus points**

* Experience with Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool.
* Experience with Argo CD or other GitOps deployment workflows.
* Experience implementing policy as code or automated security checks.
* Experience securing deployment pipelines, container images, or software supply chains.
* Experience testing security controls or supporting cloud incident investigations.
* Experience with Scaleway or Deutsche Telekom cloud environments.
* Experience in healthcare, another regulated environment, or a growing technology company.

 **On-call**


You will participate in a shared security incident response rotation, contributing cloud expertise to investigations, containment, and recovery. On-call rotations include additional compensation.

 **Location**


We are primarily hiring for our headquarters in central Stockholm, where you will work in person with the team.


For exceptional candidates, we may consider remote arrangements.

 **How to apply**


We review applications continuously and are ready to hire when we find the right person. Please apply with your CV in English.


If your experience could suit a future opening better, we may ask whether you would like us to stay in touch.


Because Tandem handles sensitive patient data, we conduct a background check before hiring.

 **Benefits**

* Competitive salary and company stock options.
* Additional compensation for on-call rotations.
* 30 days of paid holiday each year.
* 5,000 SEK wellness allowance, plus 6,000 SEK each year for other health-related initiatives.
* Parental leave top-up for new parents.
* Private medical insurance.
* Mental health support through Mindler.
* Pension programme.
* Regular social and team activities, including off-sites and seasonal events.


We review our benefits regularly and may change them from time to time.

**Culture at Tandem**
=====================

  

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.


Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.


Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.


We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.  

  

*Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.*

title: Cyber Defense Engineer
description:
**Job Description** **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


Cyber Defense Engineering designs, builds, operates and continuously improves the technical capabilities that enable H&M Group's Cyber Defense organization. We create reliable, scalable and secure platforms that help analysts detect, investigate and respond to threats quickly and effectively.


As a Cyber Defense Engineer, you will own and evolve one or more Cyber Defense capabilities. You will keep today's services dependable while engineering tomorrow's capabilities - combining security engineering with cloud, platform and software engineering practices.


You will balance operational excellence with purposeful improvement, ensuring every capability has clear ownership, measurable health and an active roadmap.


Your responsibilities:

* Own and continuously improve one or more Cyber Defense capabilities, including vision, roadmap, service health, risks, technical debt and standards.
* Design, build and operate secure cloud-native platforms and services that are resilient, observable and designed to scale.
* Engineer reliable telemetry pipelines, security integrations and automation that improve detection and response outcomes.
* Use Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD to make changes repeatable, reviewable and safe.
* Partner with analysts to translate operational needs into reusable engineering solutions and measurable security outcomes.
* Apply automation and AI thoughtfully to reduce manual effort, improve quality and augment engineering and analyst judgement.
* Define meaningful metrics and KPIs, use them to guide prioritization and communicate capability health and progress.
* Create and maintain architecture, standards, decision records, runbooks and operational documentation as part of delivery.
* Provide technical leadership through sound decisions, constructive challenge, mentoring and cross-team collaboration.

**WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH**


You will join a collaborative Cyber Defense Engineering team working closely with security analysts, incident responders, architects, platform teams and other security functions across H&M Group. Analysts help define the security outcomes; engineering owns how capabilities are designed, delivered and evolved. Together, you will turn operational insight into robust platforms and services.


Capability ownership is accountability, not individual execution. You will coordinate work across engineers and stakeholders, make trade-offs visible and ensure that the capability continues to move forward.

**WHO YOU ARE**


You are a senior engineer who thinks in systems rather than individual products. You are comfortable taking responsibility for both service reliability and long-term improvement, and you bring others with you through clear communication, practical documentation and collaborative decision-making.

*We are looking for experience in several of the following:*

* Cloud engineering in Microsoft Azure or a comparable public cloud environment.
* Linux/\*nix environments, containers and Kubernetes-based platforms.
* Programming or automation with Python, Go or a comparable language.
* Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices.
* Git-based development, code review and CI/CD pipelines.
* APIs, integrations, event-driven architectures and cloud-native services.
* Observability, monitoring, service reliability and operational metrics.
* Security telemetry, log pipelines and handling data at enterprise scale.
* Security engineering, SIEM/SOAR, Microsoft Sentinel/Defender or comparable platforms.
* Technical roadmaps, architecture documentation and lifecycle ownership.


We do not expect you to know every technology. We value strong engineering judgement, the ability to learn and evidence that you can improve complex services over time.


Your way of working:

* You take ownership and follow work through to measurable outcomes.
* You balance operational urgency with sustainable engineering decisions.
* You make complex topics understandable to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* You value documentation, automation, testing and peer review as part of engineering quality.
* You challenge manual work and recurring failure modes with curiosity and pragmatism.
* You collaborate across organisational boundaries and help others grow.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**


During your first 12 months, you will have:

* Become a trusted owner or co-owner of one or more Cyber Defense capabilities.
* Established a clear roadmap and a shared view of capability health, risks and priorities.
* Delivered measurable reliability, scalability, quality or security improvements.
* Reduced recurring operational effort through automation and better platform design.
* Improved engineering standards, documentation and ways of working.
* Built strong relationships with analysts and partner engineering teams.
* Demonstrated technical leadership through decisions, delivery and collaboration.

**WHERE YOU MAY CONTRIBUTE FIRST**


Your initial assignment will be shaped by your experience and the team's priorities. It may span one or more of our capability areas, a few of our capabilities that you may work with:

* Security Telemetry Engineering: Trusted, scalable and cost-conscious security data pipelines.
* Security Platform Engineering: Reliable cloud-native foundations and shared engineering services.
* Detection Engineering: Engineering practices and platforms that improve detection quality and lifecycle
* Security Automation & AI: Automation that improves speed, consistency and human decision-making
* Security Integrations: Secure, reusable connections across tools, data and operational workflows

**WHO WE ARE**


H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.


We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.


**WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE**


You will have the opportunity to shape long-term Cyber Defense capabilities in a global enterprise, working with modern cloud technologies, platform engineering, automation and AI. The role combines meaningful security outcomes with the freedom and responsibility to improve how engineering is done.


We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.


In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.


JOIN US


Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.


Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.
 

*\*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.*

title: Senior Account Manager

Sinch is a global leader in cloud communications, helping businesses connect with their customers through messaging, voice, and email. Our platform powers billions of interactions every year — from transactional alerts and marketing campaigns to rich, AI-driven conversations.


We're at an inflection point. As enterprise communication shifts from one-way messaging to intelligent, multi-turn conversations, Sinch is building the products and infrastructure that will define this next chapter. title: VP Enterprise Architecture
description:
*As VP Enterprise Architecture, you will play a critical role in delivering Matas Group’s transformation by ensuring that our technology landscape can support where the business is heading. You will set the architectural direction for the Group, turn transformation priorities into concrete technology choices and roadmaps, and create the guardrails that enable us to transform with greater speed, scalability and coherence.*

**Turn our transformation ambitions into architectural direction**  

Reporting to the EVP Digital, Tech & AI Transformation, you will lead a team of 5 FTE and own Enterprise Architecture across the Group. Working at the intersection of strategy, transformation, and technology, your key mandate is to ensure that architecture actively enables the transformation of our business.


You will create a coherent view of how our technology landscape needs to evolve, translate this into actionable target architectures and roadmaps, and ensure that strategic technology decisions support both transformation priorities and our long-term ambitions.


A key part of your role will be connecting business and technology across all levels of the organisation. You must be equally comfortable discussing architecture and technical trade-offs with Solution Architects as you are translating their implications into clear choices for C-level executives. Your ability to create alignment and turn complex technology questions into decisions and action will be critical.

**Your key responsibilities will include:**

* **Enable our Nordic transformation through architecture**, ensuring that strategic business priorities translate into the capabilities, platforms, and architectural changes needed to deliver them.
* **Shape an AI-ready enterprise architecture**, ensuring that our platforms, integration landscape and technology standards enable scalable adoption of AI and emerging technologies across the Group.
* **Translate strategy into executable technology roadmaps**, creating clarity on required changes, dependencies, sequencing and investments.
* **Drive architectural simplification and modernisation**, reducing unnecessary complexity and creating a more scalable, resilient and transformation-ready technology landscape.
* **Establish clear architecture governance and guardrails** that protect long-term architectural integrity while enabling teams to move faster.

title: System Architect - VCT EE Architecture
description:
*TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more:* *www.traton.com*  

  



*Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do.*

  

Modern commercial vehicles are becoming increasingly software-defined, connected and intelligent. AI can help us turn customer needs into solutions faster—and is set to reshape the transport business. Centralized computing, cloud-connected services, better and faster communication interfaces and modularization are key building blocks of evolving EE architectures. Add diagnostics, cybersecurity and safety to the mix, and the challenge is real.

  

To support the technical transformation, we are looking for a **System Architect** to join the leadership triad of **VCT EE Architecture**. This is a role for someone who enjoys understanding the bigger picture, connecting technical disciplines and helping others make better architectural decisions.

  

The role offers the flexibility to be based in any of the locations where the Group HR R&D organization operates (Munich, Germany; Södertälje, Sweden; Lisle, USA), depending on the candidate’s preference and location.

  

**Role Summary**
----------------

  

As System Architect, you are responsible for the technical direction of the VCT. Together with the Product Manager and the RTE, you form the VCT triad, ensuring that the architecture evolves in line with both current delivery needs and our long-term vision.

  

This is a role where your expertise in technology blends with specialists from different domains, and together work out dependencies and possibilities, helping the organization move in the same direction at a high pace.

  

Our mission spans a wide range of areas—from functional and hardware architecture to diagnostics, cybersecurity and system integration. Your task is to make sure the pieces fit together and enable the architecture to support our future products across the TRATON Group.

  

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

  

You will:


* Lead the architectural work in the VCT.
* Drive technical decisions together with other architects, developers and product teams.
* Balance short-term delivery with long-term architectural sustainability.
* Identify dependencies and opportunities across multiple technical domains.
* Define and evolve architectural principles, interfaces and reference solutions.
* Represent the VCT in architectural forums across TRATON Group R&D.
* Support teams in making sound architectural decisions without becoming a bottleneck.
  

As our new Group is part of TRATON Group, we are closely collaborating with all brands in the Group. In your role it’s therefore important to have a Group perspective while taking all brands into consideration.

  

**Who You Are**
---------------

  

We believe you are someone who enjoys solving complex problems and making sense of large technical systems.

  

You don't need to know every detail from start, but you are comfortable discussing architecture across several engineering disciplines and asking the right questions to reach good decisions.

  

You probably have experience as a System Architect, Lead Engineer or similar roles where you've worked with complex embedded systems and collaborated across organizational boundaries.

  

Just as important as your technical background is your ability to build trust, communicate clearly and create alignment between different stakeholders.

  

**We'd like you to bring**


* Experience in system or EE architecture within complex embedded systems.
* A broad understanding of vehicle electrical and electronic systems.
* The ability to connect different technical perspectives into a coherent solution.
* Experience working across teams and disciplines.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Curiosity, sound engineering judgement and a genuine interest in architecture.
  

Experience from working in areas such as diagnostics, cybersecurity, functional architecture, hardware architecture, vehicle networks or systems engineering is an advantage.

  

  

  

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives are valuable to us.  



**This Is Us**
--------------

  

Few architecture roles offer this breadth.

  

In VCT EE Architecture, you'll work with many of the technologies that define tomorrow's vehicles. You'll collaborate with experts across the TRATON Group and help shape the architectural foundation used by several brands.

  

If you enjoy understanding complex systems, connecting people and technology, and influencing the future of commercial vehicles, we'd love to hear from you.

  

Within TRATON Group R&D, you are an important part of something bigger. Joining us means gaining access to the ins and outs of the entire transportation industry. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Being bigger also means being stronger. Together with our brands, we have the collective power to transform transportation.

  

**Application**
---------------

  

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

  

*Apply as soon as possible, no later than 14th of December 2026.*Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

  

**Cross-Brand Recruiting**


By applying for this position, please be aware that we will share your application details and documents within TRATON GROUP brands and entities to be able to ensure a group-wide recruiting process.

  

**If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:**


Hiring Manager: Thomas Strange - TGRESA, +46 70 081 55 43, thomas.strange@scania.com


Lead Recruiter: Anna Choynowska, TA Specialist, anna.choynowska@scania.com

  

**We look forward to your application!**

title: Certificate Authority Program Steward
description:
**Why Mozilla?**



Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.



The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute **open-source** software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.


**What you’ll do:**


* **Manage Mozilla’s root store:** Make root store management your primary responsibility, through public review processes, and policy and audit evaluations and using certificate analysis tools, the Common CA Database (CCADB), to process root inclusions, trust changes, and removals and maintain accurate trust and revocation data.
* **Evaluate CA compliance and investigate incidents:** Review certificates, CA policies, audit reports, and incident responses. Identify gaps, ask precise follow-up questions, assess corrective actions, and support informed trust decisions.
* **Develop security policy and standards:** Contribute to Mozilla’s Root Store Policy, program guidance, and CCADB and CA/Browser Forum requirements through technical analysis, clear drafting, and constructive public discussion.
* **Coordinate work and build program expertise:** Collaborate with CAs, Mozilla engineers, auditors, and other root store operators to resolve issues and advance projects. Work closely with the CA Program Manager, document processes and decisions, and take on increasing responsibility.
* **Improve tools and automate CA program tasks:** Maintain and enhance supporting tools and workflows. Use AI coding assistants and software tools to streamline certificate analysis, compliance review, data reconciliation, reporting, and documentation, with appropriate validation and human review.


**What you’ll bring:**


* **Understanding of the Web PKI and internet security:** Working knowledge of digital certificates, public key cryptography, TLS, certificate chains, and revocation, including how technical requirements and CA practices establish trust. Awareness of emerging threats and developments, including post-quantum cryptography, and an interest in evaluating their implications for browser trust and CA operations.
* **Practical software engineering and automation skills:** Experience developing, maintaining, testing, and debugging tools or services using existing codebases, APIs, structured data, Git-based workflows, and cloud applications.
* **CA compliance and audit evaluation:** Ability to critically evaluate Certificate Policies and Certification Practice Statements (CP/CPS), independent audit reports, and incident analyses against applicable requirements. Familiarity with industry requirements and WebTrust and ETSI audit frameworks and the ability to identify gaps, assess supporting evidence, and formulate precise follow-up questions.
* **Analytical judgment and program management:** Ability to investigate technical evidence, interpret specifications and policy requirements, and reach evidence-based conclusions. Prioritize competing requests, coordinate stakeholders, and follow complex issues through to resolution.
* **Clear communication and effective collaboration:** Excellent written communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions, write precise documentation and constructive questions, guide public discussions, and navigate disagreement professionally. Work effectively with distributed teams and external stakeholders, seek feedback, and share knowledge while developing broader technical and program expertise.


**What you’ll get:**


* Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
* Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
* Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
* Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
* One-time home office stipend
* Annual professional development budget
* Quarterly well-being stipend
* Considerable paid parental leave
* Employee referral bonus program
* Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)


**About Mozilla**



Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.


**Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging**



Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.



We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation.



We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

Freedom and flexibility

title: Billing & Revenue Accountant
description:
**Build something monumental for Healthcare!**
==============================================

  

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.


We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

**About the Role**
------------------


As Billing & Revenue Accountant at Tandem, you will own what happens after a contract is signed, ensuring revenue is billed accurately, collected on time, and recognised correctly across all of our entities.


You’ll work closely with Finance, our outsourced accounting partners, and commercial teams, as well as our Finance Associate, who has been driving much of our quote-to-cash process in recent months.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Ensure contracts are billed correctly in Stripe, with the right VAT and currency for each market, and own the controls over our automated billing flows, including AI-assisted ones.
* Handle non-standard contracts, partner and rev-share invoicing, credit notes, and subscription changes, renewals, and cancellations.
* Run dunning and collections, and answer billing questions from customers, Sales, and Customer Success.
* Execute cash application, AR and bank reconciliation in Light, our ERP, plus month-end close and audit support.
* Prepare the inputs for revenue recognition (deferred revenue, accruals) and VAT reporting with our outsourced accountants, and check their output.
* Check that billing matches contracts, keep documentation current, and keep the work audit-ready.
* Proactively work with the team on system and process improvement projects and use AI and automation tools to remove manual work.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 4+ years in accounting, audit, billing, or AR, with at least 1 year in a SaaS or subscription business.
* Hands-on experience with Stripe or a similar billing platform.
* You use AI tools daily and like turning manual work into automated work.
* Working knowledge of revenue recognition basics (deferred revenue, accruals, cut-off) and multi-market VAT.
* ERP experience, ideally with Light or a comparable cloud system.
* Outcome-focused: you want revenue recognition and dunning to be right, not just done.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and with processes that change as we scale.
* Multi-entity and multi-currency billing (FX and VAT complexity) experience would be a bonus!

**Location**
------------


We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This is a **full-time role based in Stockholm** where you will work primarily in order to collaborate, connect, and build our culture.

  

**How to Apply**
----------------


We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.


Our interview process consists of stages:

* Screening interview with Talent Acquisition
* First interview with our Finance Director
* Second interview with our Finance Associate
* Working Day - Join us in the Stockholm office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

  

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive salary & company stock options
* 30 days/year of paid vacation
* 5,000 SEK wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag) plus an additional 6,000 SEK yearly to spend on other health related initiatives
* Generous Parental leave top-up for new parents
* Private Medical Insurance to stay healthy
* Mental health support through our partner Mindler
* Pension program
* Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)
* An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare
* Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering.

 *We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time.*

**Culture at Tandem**
=====================

  

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.


Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.


Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.


We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.  

  

*Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.*

description:

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.


We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

**About the role**


You will help our security team deliver improvements that protect Tandem, our customers, and the sensitive patient data entrusted to us.


You will turn security goals into actionable plans and drive work through to completion. Your work will include coordinating improvements that span multiple teams and delivering programmes of risk reduction across the business.


Working closely with the Head of Security, engineers, and colleagues across Tandem, you will bring structure to complex work. You will make dependencies visible, maintain useful plans, resolve delivery blockers, and help stakeholders make timely decisions.


You will also improve how the security team delivers. Clear ownership, dependable coordination, and useful reporting should make it easier for technical colleagues to focus on execution.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Vår kund söker en teknisk projektledare som ersättare till CLiQ, ett omfattande digitaliseringsprogram. Projektet syftar till att förändra organisationens hantering av produktdata, främst genom att införa Teamcenter PLM som det primära systemet för produktdata och därmed överta denna funktion från ERP-systemet. Övergången till Teamcenter kommer att möjliggöra ytterligare effektiviseringar genom nya processer och verktyg för ändringshantering, produktkonfiguration, industrialisering och kravhantering. De första delarna av programmet har redan implementerats hos slutanvändarna, men ett omfattande arbete återstår.
  
  

Cirka 40 personer arbetar inom projektets fem aktiva arbetsströmmar. Som teknisk projektledare kommer du att arbeta tillsammans med projektledaren för att säkerställa att projektet uppnår sina tekniska leverans- och kvalitetsmål. Huvudsakliga ansvarsområden Tekniskt ledarskap – Leda och vägleda projektteamen i tekniska frågor samt säkerställa att arbetet ligger i linje med projektets övergripande mål. Teknisk roadmap – Utveckla och underhålla en teknisk roadmap i linje med verksamhetens utvecklingsmål.
  
  

Systemarkitektur (i samarbete med systemarkitekt) – Övervaka utformningen och arkitekturen för projektets IT-system samt säkerställa skalbarhet och effektivitet. Integrationsplanering – Planera och samordna integrationen av tekniska komponenter för att leverera sammanhängande IT-lösningar. Teknisk riskhantering – Identifiera och bedöma tekniska risker samt utveckla strategier för att minimera dessa. Leverantörshantering – Hantera relationer med externa leverantörer och teknikpartners för att stödja projektets mål.
  
  

Prestandaoptimering – Optimera prestandan i IT-system och applikationer för att möta verksamhetens och användarnas krav. Säkerhet och regelefterlevnad – Säkerställa att IT-lösningarna uppfyller säkerhetsstandarder och följer branschens bästa praxis. Teknik- och branschkunskap – Hålla sig uppdaterad om nya teknologier och branschtrender, bedöma deras potentiella påverkan på projektet samt använda teknisk kompetens för att fatta välgrundade beslut. Önskade kvalifikationer Mycket god ledarskapsförmåga.
  
  

Erfarenhet av att leda tvärfunktionella projekt med många intressenter. God planeringsförmåga. Erfarenhet av IT och systemimplementering. Mycket god förmåga att bedöma resursbehov och fördela resurser utifrån dessa.
  
  

Goda generella projektledningskunskaper, inklusive resurshantering, tidsplanering, budget och riskhantering. Meriterande kvalifikationer Tidigare erfarenhet av Product Lifecycle Management-system (PLM), särskilt Teamcenter. Erfarenhet av organisatorisk förändringsledning. Erfarenhet från flyg- och/eller försvarsindustrin.
  
  

Nyckelord – huvudsakliga system som omfattas av projektet CATIA V5 Teamcenter (AW, 2512) Designcenter NX (2512) Xpedition/EDM JIRA Capital IFS Cloud Confluence Kan detta vara ett uppdrag som passar dig? Sök redan i dag eller kontakta oss så berättar vi gärna mer. Vi behöver en ansökan inkluderat CV och personligt brev på svenska som matchar vår kunds krav. Kunden kan fatta beslut tidigare än sista ansökningsdatum, urval och intervjuer sker löpande.
  
  

NXT Interim och NXT Rekrytering är ett nischat och innovativt företag som är verksamma inom konsult och rekryteringsbranschen. Vi är verksamma inom HR, IT, Ekonomi, Sälj och Marknad och har över 20 års erfarenhet i branschen. Vi erbjuder våra konsulter bl.a sjukförsäkring, remote-arbetsplatser och flera andra förmåner som förgyller deras vardag. Vid anställning tillämpar vi kollektivavtal.

title: Principal Consultant, Embedded Industrial AI
description:

**Job Description**
-------------------


***Are you motivated by shaping how industrial organizations design and scale intelligent embedded systems and edge AI in real-world environments? Do you thrive at the intersection of strategy and execution, helping customers move from emerging edge AI concepts to robust, production-ready solutions that transform how products, machines, vehicles and production lines are built and operated in industrial manufacturing and defence?***


Etteplan is strengthening its Advisory Services and is now looking for a Principal Consultant, Embedded Industrial AI to join our newly established Advisory team within Software and Embedded Solutions (SES).


You bring the embedded systems and edge AI depth to earn credibility with architects and engineers, and the advisory seniority to earn the trust of C-level executives. You also take ownership of our Embedded Industrial AI offering.


**Your role**


AI in a cloud demo and AI in a machine are two very different things. As Principal Consultant, you lead early-phase engagements that take customers from a candidate use case to deployed, owned AI. You start from what is holding production, the product or growth back, and how technology, data and AI can solve it as a whole. Then you set the direction: target architectures (including where inference runs and on what hardware), solution concepts and the shape of the pilot, proven on real production data before you hand over to delivery with continuity. Hands-on building stays with our delivery teams.


You are the advisor customers call and trust, sitting with C-level and business leadership. Inside Etteplan, you own the Embedded Industrial AI offering and guide our organization in the area. This is one of the founding Principal positions in a growing global Advisory team, so you define the offering rather than inherit it.


**Your main responsibilities include**


* Leading early-phase embedded systems and edge AI engagements: discovery, roadmaps, use-case qualification and feasibility
* Advising customers on where AI stalls between pilot and production (pilots that never scale, no owner after go-live, AI stuck outside the product, compliance arriving too late) and on how to avoid it
* Translating industrial challenges into problem statements, architectures and roadmaps with KPIs agreed upfront, and with lifecycle, certification and regulatory evidence (functional safety, AI Act, CRA) designed in from the start
* Opening new customers and creating demand for Etteplan’s productized services together with solution sales, shaping deals with insight and technical leadership
* Owning the Embedded Industrial AI offering and helping grow the team and the business
* Mentoring engineers and architects across Business Units as a role model

**Who we are looking for**


Deep embedded systems and edge AI expertise is only the start. You know that on a machine reliability matters, safety is non-negotiable, observability is essential and the edge cases are not hypothetical. What sets you apart is the ability to use that depth in client conversations: to listen well, ask the questions that unlock what a client needs, and make complexity clear without losing precision. You are as at home in the boardroom as on the shop floor, challenge executives constructively and with evidence, and think business value first, measuring AI against scrap, yield, downtime and throughput rather than model accuracy. You enjoy opening doors as much as advising behind them, and you want to own an offering and grow a team and a business, not only deliver engagements.


**Must-have requirements**


* 10+ years in consulting, advisory or senior client-facing roles, leading senior stakeholder engagements
* Embedded software and/or hardware background with hands-on ML deployment on constrained edge hardware
* A track record of taking AI from pilot to production in industrial settings, and knowing why initiatives fail
* Background in manufacturing, industrial machinery, defence, energy, automotive or other engineering-driven domains
* Ability to turn ambiguous challenges into structured direction and bridge strategy and execution
* Comfort in international, multi-disciplinary environments and fluent English

**Nice to have**


* MLOps, functional safety, Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), test automation / V&V, or industrial robotics experience
* An advanced technical degree
* Fluent in Swedish, Finnish or German
* Eligibility for Swedish security clearance

**What we offer**


At Etteplan, you will work at the forefront of Industrial AI, helping shape how intelligence is embedded into industrial products, systems and development processes. You will join a growing global Advisory team with strong strategic backing and consultants across industrial data & AI, enterprise architecture, autonomous systems, IT/OT, agentic AI and strategy. You will have the opportunity to:


* Define the Embedded Industrial AI offering and lead its growth within a global engineering company
* Start with Nordic industrial, defence and machinery leaders who already trust Etteplan with their engineering and want to talk about the business problems AI should solve
* See your advice implemented end to end, from machine design to embedded software and production support
* Join a collaborative team where your expertise is valued and trusted

**Application**


Sounds like the right opportunity for you? Apply through our recruitment system by 13 December. We review applications continuously. Preferred location is Stockholm, but also Linköping is possible, with international collaboration and some travel. For additional information, please contact Nilesh Sakarikar (nilesh.sakarikar@etteplan.com).


**Great Place to Work**
-----------------------


* Bicycle benefit
* Talent Referral Bonus
* Maximum wellness allowance
* Car leasing benefit
* Personal development: training programs & career model
* Collective agreements & local union representatives
* Parental leave with up to 90% of your salary
* Work-life balance, flexible working hours, and hybrid work
* Gross salary deductions for items such as 3D printers, tablets, headphones, home office equipment, etc.
* Private healthcare insurance

  
**About the company**
---------------------


Etteplan is a leading technical consulting company shaping the industries of the future. With a dynamic and inclusive work culture, we offer exciting assignments, diverse customer relationships and an environment where your ambition can flourish. We are over 700 technology specialists in Sweden who are passionate about technology and people. Together, we shape the innovations and developments of the future within a global business environment. With us, there are many opportunities for those who want to grow and develop in a forward-looking organization.

  

Forward focusWe take pride and ownership in our work as well as our personal and professional growth. For us, new technologies are opportunities waiting to be turned into our competitive advantage. With our foresight and proactive mindset, we advance the success of both our customers and Etteplan.


Bold thinkingWe explore new horizons, challenge ideas, and actively propose innovative solutions. We promote an environment of open dialogue, where we have the freedom to voice our opinions openly and honestly without fear of judgment.


Smarter togetherWe share ideas with one another, not just with our closest colleagues but across different disciplines and service areas. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) — AI & Solutions**

  

Join us at Zendesk, where we're on a mission to power exceptional service for every person on the planet. We're accelerating that ambition by building products rooted in AI, automation, and intelligent customer experiences, because behind every interaction lies an opportunity to make a human connection.


We’re hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our Technical Presales team. Where you’ll be an elite hybrid: part software engineer, part strategic consultant. You’ll do more than just sell the dream, you’ll execute what’s possible.
  

  

In this role you’ll be embedded with strategic customers to design, build, and deliver production-grade AI solutions that unlock measurable ROI. You’ll translate customer needs into robust integrations, architect LLM-powered workflows, and collaborate cross-functionally to turn real-world friction into product improvements.


You will play a vital role in growing Zendesk’s enterprise footprint by delivering high-impact, scalable AI deployments. Building trusted technical partnerships, delivering crisp, production-ready solutions, and amplifying Zendesk’s AI capabilities within complex, high-value accounts.  



  

**What you’ll be doing**

* Lead end-to-end technical delivery of AI agent and LLM-powered solutions: discovery, scoping, system design, PoC, production rollout, and operational handoff.
* Build production-grade integrations and custom connectors (APIs, data pipelines, RAG systems) to surface high-quality signals into Zendesk AI workflows.
* Troubleshoot and resolve escalated technical blockers across data, infra, and model behavior. Act as the field’s final line of defense for complex issues.
* Collaborate closely with Sales engineering and product teams to map undocumented systems, define integration patterns, and implement solutions.
Translate customer learnings into product feedback and prioritized roadmap items; partner with Zendesk Product and Engineering to reduce future deployment friction.  
* 

  

**What you bring to the role**

* **Founder mindset:** comfortable navigating ambiguity, mapping unknown systems, and delivering results without a predefined playbook.
* **Engineering rigor:** 5+ years building production systems; strong software engineering fundamentals and attention to quality.
* **Full-stack fluency:** experience across frontend (React/TypeScript), backend (Python / Node / Java / Ruby), REST/GraphQL APIs, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* **AI/LLM expertise:** practical experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector stores, and evaluation/guardrails for model safety and reliability.
* **Systems integrator:** proven ability to design secure data ingestion, ETL/data pipelines, and work with diverse data stores and message systems.
* **Excellent communicator:** able to present trade-offs to executives and pair-program with customer engineers; strong written runbooks and documentation skills.
* **Travel readiness:** willing to travel as needed to customer sites (typical range 25–50%).

  

**Basic qualifications**

* 5+ years software engineering experience delivering production systems.
* Prior FDE, Professional Services, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Account Management experience delivering enterprise AI or SaaS deployments.
* Proficient in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript; experience with at least one backend language (Java, Ruby, or Go) preferred.
* Hands-on experience deploying or integrating LLM-based solutions in production (RAG, vector DBs, model evaluation).
* Practical experience with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) and containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Comfortable working onsite with customers and traveling up to 50% as required.
Swedish and English language proficiency required.  
* 

  

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience with specific LLM tooling and frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, or similar).
* Familiarity with Zendesk products and APIs, or experience integrating customer support/contact-center platforms.
* Background in observability and operationalization of ML/AI (monitoring, SLOs, cost controls, retraining pipelines).
* Experience with data governance, PII handling, and enterprise security/compliance constraints.

Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.


Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.
