title: Group Process Specialist
description:
We are now looking for an experienced and self-driven **Group Process Specialist** who wants to take overarching responsibility for developing, improving and supporting our financial processes and systems. The role suits you who have a broad understanding of Finance, are confident in system environments and enjoy driving issues all the way from needs and analysis to testing, implementation and a stable solution.


You will be an important link between Group Finance, IT, Master Data, our local operations and external system vendors.

**About the role**


As **Group Process Specialist** you have overall responsibility for managing and further developing our financial processes, systems and data. The focus is on Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), bank, VAT and financial master data, but the role also touches other areas within the finance solutions.


You coach and support our super users, further develop our common solution and manage it. You also make sure that changes and new needs are assessed against the whole, so that the solution holds together across the entire Group.


Among other things, you will:

* be responsible for and develop processes and system support within Finance processes and related areas, and act as the bridge between the business, legal requirements and the system solution
* work with ERP systems, invoice management systems and related system integrations
* plan and carry out tests and support deployment and follow-up of changes
* analyze problems and deviations and, together with IT and external vendors, find sustainable solutions
* work hands-on with financial data, for example through analysis, structuring, mapping, quality assurance and validation
* prepare and quality-assure migration files and uploads in connection with system changes and implementations
* support users and super users and handle training, documentation and user access
* contribute to increased automation, digitalization and harmonization of our Finance processes, including through smart use of AI


An important part of the role is contributing Finance expertise to implementation and migration projects. You work for harmonized processes within the Group. This may, for example, involve preparing and quality-assuring data for fixed assets, WIP and open items when migrating from legacy systems to **Infor M3 Public Cloud**.


You work closely with our specialists in IT and Master Data, but with a clear Finance perspective and responsibility for ensuring that the solutions work in the business. You translate needs from Finance in the various countries, and from processes that have been added or changed in other business areas, into common solutions for the whole Group.

**Who are you?**


We believe you are an experienced Finance specialist who enjoys combining financial understanding with process development, systems and data. You are used to independently driving issues forward and feel comfortable in a role with many points of contact.


We would like you to have:

* broad experience of financial processes, primarily within Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, bank, VAT and master data
* experience of ERP-based Finance processes and system management
* good understanding of system integrations and the ability to troubleshoot functional problems together with technical specialists
* practical experience of data analysis, data quality, data mapping, migration and uploading of data
* very good skills in **Excel** and experience of working in a structured way with large volumes of data
* experience of defining requirements for, testing and implementing changes in processes and systems
* the ability to document ways of working and to train and support users and super users
* an interest in, and preferably experience of, using AI to make Finance processes more efficient
* Fluency in English, both spoken and written, is required. The ability to understand and work in at least one Scandinavian language (Swedish, Norwegian or Danish) is a strong advantage.


Experience of ERP implementations, Infor M3 Public Cloud, Rillion or other relevant data, import and analysis tools is particularly valuable.

**As a person**


To succeed as **Group Process Specialist**, we believe you are **self-driven, analytical and structured**, while finding it easy to collaborate with different parts of the organization.


You do not need to be an IT specialist yourself, but you enjoy understanding how systems and data fit together and are confident in dialogue with technical specialists and solution providers.


You are humble and solution-oriented and can switch between detail and the big picture. Above all, you are curious about how **automation, digitalization and smarter use of data and AI** can make Finance processes simpler, more efficient and of higher quality.

title: Head of Cyber Security
description:
**About the Role**  

Every booking, payment and guest profile that moves through VISIT depends on trust. As Head of Cyber Security, you'll own that trust across the whole Group: the strategy, the controls and how they work day to day, across every product and our corporate IT. You'll report to the CTO and be part of the Technology Leadership Team.

**What You Will Do**

* Shape and own the Group security strategy, roadmap and information security management system, with a clear view of risk for leadership.
* Build security into how we design and ship software together with the Group Chief Architect, from secure coding and threat modeling to vulnerability management and penetration testing, and manage our cloud security posture across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud.
* Set the security standards for identity, endpoints and corporate IT together with the Head of IT, and run our security awareness program.
* Lead security operations and incident response with our managed SOC partner, and take command when a security incident happens.
* Drive compliance and resilience across the countries we operate in, including GDPR, PCI DSS, NIS2 and ISO 27001 certification, and coordinate data protection (DPO) activities across the organization.
* Own third-party security risk and security due diligence for acquisitions, bringing new businesses onto Group standards.
* Build and lead a small security function and a network of security champions across our squads, platform team and IT.
* Report on risk, posture and investment needs to the CTO, the Executive Leadership Team and the Board, in plain language.

 **Who You Are**

* You have 10+ years of experience in information and cyber security, including 5+ years leading a security function or program, with hands-on depth as well as leadership.
* You have defined, implemented and operated security controls for an organization of comparable scale: several hundred people, multiple legal entities across several countries, multiple products and technology stacks, and a mix of on-premise, Azure and AWS hosting.
* You have led the response to serious security incidents, including personal data breaches with regulatory notification under GDPR and customer communications, and run security operations with a managed SOC or MDR partner.
* You have strong working knowledge of the Microsoft security stack (Entra ID, Conditional Access, Defender, Intune) and of cloud security in Azure and AWS, including an edge and WAF platform such as Cloudflare, and you have implemented ISO 27001 or an equivalent framework, worked with PCI DSS and GDPR, and understand NIS2 and its Nordic transpositions.
* You're pragmatic and risk-based. You prioritize well within a budget and explain risk and investment clearly to executives and boards.
* Experience securing a business built through acquisition, certifications such as CISSP, CISM or CCSP, a background in travel, hospitality, booking, payments or B2B SaaS, experience with private equity ownership, using AI in security operations, or a Nordic language is a plus.
* Fluent English is required for this role.

**Why VISIT?**  

At VISIT, we believe in experiences that move us and change us, and in the people who help create them. We only grow when our customers do, so we work side by side, with them and with each other.


What you can expect:

* A team that shares knowledge, solves challenges side by side and celebrates success together
* Real ownership, and colleagues who stand by what they promise
* An industry that never stands still, with room to learn, adapt and evolve with it
* An international environment with colleagues across more than 10 countries

**Location & Ways of Working**  

Hybrid, based in Gothenburg, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Oslo or Berlin. The role includes occasional travel to our engineering and IT locations, partners and customers.

**Interested?**  

We'd love to hear from you. Apply now, and let's grow together.

**About VISIT**  

VISIT is a platform that brings together everything hospitality, experience, and short-term rentals need to be efficient, profitable and make connections that deliver captivating guest experiences.


Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, VISIT has grown into a team of 400+ employees across more than 10 countries, serving 10,000+ customers in 150+ countries.

title: Data Center Technician
description:
**Overview**  

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will demonstrate expertise in standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning equipment, as well as a holistic understanding of the functions of, and interactions between, network and server equipment. You will provide input for suggested modifications to these processes and procedures as needed to improve service quality and efficiency while providing guidance to other technicians.

  

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

  

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

  

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

  

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Apply advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting expertise to quickly identify the cause(s) of issues to quickly identify the cause of issues.
* Decommission hardware for complex changes and/or systems with complex interactions (e.g., upgrading entire racks) following standard procedures.
* Delegate hardware installation, deployment, and/or replacement work to technicians while providing expert guidance for preparing, staging, setting up, and performing startups and shutdowns (e.g., racks, hard drives, switches).
* Ensure quality execution as defined by organizational standards, coordinating downtime, and keeping relevant stakeholders informed of work status to minimize downstream rework.
* Assist and provide guidance to technicians to complete challenging or complex tasks and escalate issues as needed.
* Ensure that technicians are performing post-execution quality checks and verifying that grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling are set up in compliance with safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Tasks (NDTs).
* Verify security compliance for decommissions and processes data-bearing devices for destruction.
* Maintain an awareness of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) through dashboards and/or monthly performance discussions.
* Train and mentor technicians through on-the-job training and by providing direct guidance on specific tasks.
* Attend, conduct, or assist in conducting daily safety briefings, completes required safety training, provides guidance to technicians to facilitate compliance with safety procedures (e.g., Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) usage, equipment use, lifting, electrical hazards, ladder/rolling stair use).
* Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and resulting user experience.
* Embody our culture and values.

  

**Qualifications**  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Completed High/Secondary School, GED, an apprenticeship/vocational qualification, or equivalent experience and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components.
* Experienced in diagnostics, troubleshooting , route cause analysis of hardware deployments.
* Experience of Decommissioning and Upgrading hardware.
* You will be required to travel between sites as part of this role so a valid driver’s license will be required.

 **Background Check Requirements:**


Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

  

While not required, we also look for the following**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Associate degree in computer science or other field and/or equivalent work experience.
* Experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
* Experience working in a production, mission-critical 24x7x365 data center environment.
* Applicable certifications: ASICS/Inventory Control, CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC), Data Center Foundation Certification (DCFC), Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP), Vendor-Specific Network Certifications.

You'll work on integrated teams alongside our general consultants and clients to develop data-driven strategies and innovative solutions. Together, we create human-centric solutions that harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to drive competitive advantage. Our collaborative and supportive environment fosters creativity and continuous learning, enabling us to consistently deliver exceptional results.
  
  

WHAT YOU'LL DO
  
* Drive client improvements in AI-assisted or AI-led maturity across people, process, and technology.
* Mentor and coach developers to improve productivity through adoption of AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex etc.)
* Lead in designing, developing, and documenting AI applications aligned to business outcomes.
* Develop prompt engineering strategies, implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and optimize model inference latency and cost
* Develop and champion modern software development best practices and concepts to technical audience and business stakeholders.
* Lead cross functional teams to develop and deploy production quality code for clients.
* Lead full software development life cycle execution including architecture design, writing documentation and unit/integration tests, identifying issues and resolution, writing clean code, conducting code reviews, and mentoring other Engineers.
* Travel is required (~25%).


Provide technical guidance to external clients and internal stakeholders in Bain (80%):
  
* Drive AI-led or AI-assisted transformation to improve productivity and quality across the PDLC
* Explore new innovations in AI and software development to further improve productivity and modularity.
* Mentor and coach engineering teams on technology stack best practices and operational models to raise their software engineering capabilities.
* Lead ideation processes, alongside consulting and client colleagues, to bring innovative solutions to problems.
* Drive engagements that help to understand current state of clients’ architecture, micro-services, build processes, and security needs.
* Lead in a collaborative manner with clients’ technical teams to define technical approaches to implementing designed solutions, including new product architecture, data flows and integration strategies, and build processes.


Scope, architect, design, develop, build, and release robust and scalable applications (20%):
  
  

* Translate business requirements into technical requirements and implementation details
* Lead development of complex systems that are extensible, easy to understand, and self-maintaining.
* Design integrations with third-party systems to enable use cases that power business solutions.
* Work closely with product and design to create modern AI systems.
* Architect and design end-to-end AI agent systems, including reasoning loops, planning mechanisms, and tool orchestration frameworks
* Develop and optimize LLM-powered applications using advanced prompting, structured outputs, and model routing strategies
* Design and implement multi-agent architectures (planner, executor, verifier, critic patterns)
* Architect and build scalable retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines with optimized embedding and retrieval strategies


ABOUT YOU
  
  

**We are looking for someone who has:**  

* Bachelor’s in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent work experience.
* Experience in an engineering role at a start-up or fast-growing tech company, with a strong track record of increasing mastery and responsibility.
* 10+ years of experience with full-stack development.
* 6+ years of experience with micro-service API development (e.g., RESTful, GraphQL, gRPC) with frameworks (e.g. FastAPI, Swagger, OpenAPI etc.).
* 4+ years of experience in consulting.
* 2+ years of experience leading or managing development teams
* 1+ years of experience with AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.).
* Strong knowledge in development best practices (automated testing frameworks, CI/CD etc.).
* Strong computer science fundaments in data structures, algorithms, automated testing, object-oriented programming, performance complexity, and implications of computer architecture on software performance.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills,
* Deep understanding of large language models (LLMs) and transformer architectures
* Strong knowledge of prompt engineering, structured prompting, and reasoning control techniques
* Experience designing and deploying retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems
* Ability to evaluate model performance beyond accuracy (reasoning quality, hallucination rate, task success)
* Understanding of tokenization, context window limits, and cost optimization strategies
* Strong Python proficiency for AI development


**Ideal candidates will also have experience in:**  

* Master’s in computer science or a related technical field.
* Experience working with or providing services to enterprise customers (Fortune 500, Global 1000).
* Experience working on public cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and associated deep understanding of failover, high-availability, and high scalability.
* Ability to explain and discuss technical concepts and methodologies with colleagues and clients from other disciplines.


ABOUT US
  
  

Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future.
  
  

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes. Our 10-year commitment to invest more than $1 billion in pro bono services brings our talent, expertise, and insight to organizations tackling today’s urgent challenges in education, racial equity, social justice, economic development, and the environment. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

This compensation information has been determined based on objective and gender-neutral criteria and reflects the compensation normally applicable to the position at the time of publication.

This role is eligible for an annual performance bonus of up to 20% of base salary. Bonus awards are discretionary and actual bonus outcomes depend on individual and firm performance.
  
  

**Firm Performance Bonus (FPB) is included only if relevant:**  

This role is eligible for participation in Bain's Firm Performance Bonus (FPB) program. For the current year and this role, FPB can be up to 12% of base salary plus performance bonus, and its calculation depends on company performance. This bonus payment is discretionary.

title: ILS Ingenjör
description:
**Vill du arbeta med ILS och bidra till att skapa tillförlitliga och effektiva system genom hela deras livscykel?**


MilDef expanderar sitt team i Rosersberg och söker nu **ILS-ingenjörer** som vill vara med och utveckla framtidens försvarssystem. Här får du arbeta i en teknikintensiv och växande organisation där du tillsammans med andra specialister bidrar till att våra system är tillgängliga, underhållsbara och effektiva över tid.


Vi söker både dig med **bred erfarenhet inom Integrated Logistics Support (ILS)** och dig som har fördjupat dig inom ett eller flera specifika ILS-områden.

### **Din nya utmaning**


Som ILS-ingenjör på MilDef får du en central roll i att säkerställa våra systems funktion, tillgänglighet och underhållsmässighet genom hela livscykeln. Du arbetar nära bland annat projektledning, system engineering och konstruktion och bidrar med ILS-perspektivet genom olika delar av våra projekt.


Beroende på din tidigare erfarenhet och kompetens kan du exempelvis arbeta med analyser och beräkningar, underhållslösningar, teknisk dokumentation eller materieldata. Rollen ger dig möjlighet att både använda din specialistkunskap och utvecklas inom nya delar av ILS.


Du blir en del av en dynamisk miljö där projekten, tekniken och verksamheten fortsätter att utvecklas. Det innebär också goda möjligheter att påverka och utveckla våra arbetssätt, verktyg och processer inom ILS.

### **Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**


Beroende på din kompetens och inriktning kan arbetsuppgifterna bland annat innebära att:

* Genomföra ILS-analyser såsom driftsäkerhetsanalyser (ARMS), LCC, FMECA, RCM, MTA och LORA.
* Arbeta med underhållsberedning, reservdelsbehov och optimering.
* Följa upp och analysera fel genom exempelvis FRACAS och bidra till korrigerande åtgärder.
* Planera, samordna och genomföra ILS-leverabler inom projekt.
* Utveckla och förbättra arbetssätt, verktyg och processer inom ILS.
* Ta fram och granska teknisk information, instruktioner och dokumentation.
* Utveckla underhållsplaner, materielvårdsscheman och instruktionsböcker.
* Arbeta med teknisk dokumentation enligt relevanta standarder, exempelvis ASD S1000D.
* Arbeta med materieldata, registervård och förnödenhetsdokumentation.
* Samarbeta tvärfunktionellt med projektledning, system engineering, konstruktion och andra tekniska funktioner.

### **Vi söker dig med**

* Eftergymnasial utbildning med teknisk inriktning eller motsvarande kompetens förvärvad genom arbetslivet.
* Tidigare erfarenhet av ILS eller närliggande tekniskt område.
* God teknisk förståelse och förmåga att sätta dig in i komplexa system.
* God analytisk förmåga och ett strukturerat och noggrant arbetssätt.
* God IT-vana och mycket goda kunskaper i Microsoft Office.
* Förmåga att samarbeta effektivt med olika kompetenser och funktioner.
* Ett genuint tekniskt intresse och en vilja att kontinuerligt utveckla din kompetens.
* God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift.

### **Meriterande om du har**

* Fördjupad erfarenhet inom ett eller flera ILS-områden, exempelvis ARMS, LCC, FMECA, RCM, MTA, LORA eller FRACAS.
* Kunskap om standarder och kravställning inom ILS, exempelvis ASD S1000D.
* Erfarenhet av teknisk dokumentation och Technical Writing.
* Erfarenhet av materieldata, förnödenhetsdokumentation eller registervård.
* Erfarenhet av Teamcenter.
* Tidigare erfarenhet från Försvarsmakten eller försvarsindustrin.

**Lär känna oss**


På MilDef blir du en del av ett företag som värdesätter praktiskt engagemang, gemenskap och utveckling av ledande försvarsteknik. Hos oss får du möjlighet att utveckla nya färdigheter, bidra i tvärfunktionella projekt och göra en konkret skillnad för vår fortsatta framgång. Vi uppmuntrar kontinuerligt lärande, samarbete, och erbjuder goda möjligheter till karriärutveckling. Vi är stolta över att aktivt främja hälsa och balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Det gör vi bland annat genom att erbjuda attraktiva förmåner samt hälsofrämjande initiativ.


Vill du veta mer om MilDef, våra produkter och vår kultur? Läs mer här MilDef.com


För mer information om rollen, vänligen kontakta Magnus Lundin eller HR, Olise Andersson

###### **Viktig information**


Vi genomför drogtester på alla våra framtida kollegor innan anställning.


På grund av verksamhetens karaktär kan anställning, oavsett befattning, förutsätta bakgrunds- och säkerhetsrelaterade kontroller.


Vi arbetar med löpande urval och ser fram emot din ansökan. Under jul- och nyårsperioden kan vår återkoppling ta något längre tid än vanligt.

***MilDef - WE ARMOR IT.***

*MilDef is a global systems integrator and full-spectrum provider specializing in rugged IT for military, government and critical infrastructure sectors. MilDef provides hardware, software, and services that shield and protect critical information streams and systems, when and where the stakes are the highest. MilDef’s products are sold to more than 200 customers through companies in Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark, United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, the United States and Australia, and through partner networks in more than 40 countries. MilDef was founded in 1997 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm since 2021.*
